[CONSENT ITEM(S)]
BPW-2026-0501
RELEASE OF STOP NOTICE – KARISH INDUSTRIES, INC.
Karish Industries, Inc. is transmitting a Release of Stop Notice in the amount of $14,590.97, for wire and cable in connection with the Wilshire Blvd Grand Ave to Hoover St Stm Project. The primary contractor is Servitek Electric, Inc.
(C-200591, Communication No. 122734 - Filed August 14, 2026)
(REF: BPW-2026-0307)
